mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_price_memory (kind, partner_id, material_id, last_date, last_price, min_date, min_price, max_date, max_price, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{kind}, #{partnerId}, #{materialId}, #{date}, #{lastPrice}, #{date}, #{minPrice}, #{date}, #{maxPrice}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_price = CASE WHEN #{date} >= last_date THEN #{lastPrice} ELSE last_price END, last_date = CASE WHEN #{date} >= last_date THEN #{date} ELSE last_date END, min_date = CASE WHEN #{minPrice} < min_price THEN #{date} ELSE min_date END, min_price = CASE WHEN #{minPrice} < min_price THEN #{minPrice} ELSE min_price END, max_date = CASE WHEN #{maxPrice} > max_price THEN #{date} ELSE max_date END, max_price = CASE WHEN #{maxPrice} > max_price THEN #{maxPrice} ELSE max_price END, update_time = NOW()
